title: Embedded Reliability Cohort Playbook (45d)
summary: A tactical playbook to run a 45-day embedded reliability cohort that pairs SREs with feature teams to launch and validate SLOs. Contains sprint-level tasks, onboarding flows, experiment templates, and lightweight runbook snippets for rapid ops handoff.
objectives: Embed SREs with 3 pilot feature teams for 45 days to deliver testable SLOs and runbooks
Establish a repeatable handoff pattern so feature teams can maintain SLOs post-cohort
Surface observability gaps and prioritize 6 remediation tickets before cohort close
milestones: Week 0: Prep and intake (define teams, baseline telemetry, and run initial signal checks)
Weeks 1-2: Deep-dive and drafting SLOs + lightweight measurement dashboards
Weeks 3-4: Canary deployments, failure injection tabletop, and metrics verification
Weeks 5-6: Runbook authoring, escalation rehearsals, and ownership handoff
Day 45: Cohort review, runbook sign-off, and follow-up remediation backlog handoff
stakeholders: Feature team leads: Maya Rodriguez, Owen Chen, Lina Korhonen
success_criteria: Each pilot has an agreed SLO with measurement in dashboards
Two runbook playbooks per service with <10 min detection-to-escalation template
Observed error budget policy exercised at least once during cohort
Top 6 telemetry gaps triaged and assigned
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Feature teams pullback on pairing time -> Mitigation: reserve 3x half-days a week in calendars; exec alignment note
Risk: Dashboards lag/incorrect -> Mitigation: measurement smoke tests and synthetic probes by day 7
Risk: Incident during cohort overloads SREs -> Mitigation: pre-defined fallback policy and bridge support from Platform team
runbook_snippets: Quick detection checklist: 1) Check service latency p95/p99 and compare to baseline; 2) Verify recent deploys/rollouts in console; 3) If error budget burn > threshold, open incident and follow escalation matrix. Escalation matrix: on-call -> SRE cohort lead -> platform escalations. Triage template: hypothesis, evidence, mitigation, rollback decision, postmortem owner.
open_questions: Which teams are highest priority for cohort (prod-critical vs growth experiments)?
Do we allow experimental SLOs that rely on synthetic probes only?
What SLA for runbook delivery after handoff (30 days?)
next_steps: Send calendar invites for pairing blocks and kickoff workshop
Create JIRA epic per pilot and link to cohort board
